name: nasiko-ui-typecheck
description: Type-checking tooling for oss/ui. Dev-only: the UI has no build step, emits nothing, and ships no node_modules. See oss/ui/AGENTS.md.
//: typescript is pinned to a minor range on purpose: TS 5 and TS 7 resolve an explicit .js import differently (5 checks the .js, 7 prefers a sibling .d.ts), which changes whether the vendored Lit bundle is type-checked. Verified clean against 5.9.3.
